# openaiagents_environment_template (Resource)

A reusable OpenAI-hosted environment template (`POST /v1/agents/environments/templates`). Creating a template does not create a session or a running environment. Environment values, setup-command bodies, and inline/archive bytes are write-only; the API does not read them back. Use the corresponding `*_revision` attributes to deploy changes. Drift detection for those confidential inputs is revision-based only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openaiagents_environment_template" "skills" {
  name = "report-env"
  capability_directories = [
    "/workspace/capabilities/skills"
  ]

  network = {
    access = "restricted"
    allowed_domains = [
      "api.example.com"
    ]
  }

  packages = {
    python = ["pandas==2.2.3"]
  }

  skills = [
    {
      type     = "skill_reference"
      skill_id = "skill_abc"
      version  = "1"
    }
  ]

  plugins = [
    {
      type              = "inline"
      name              = "docs-helper"
      description       = "Find answers in documentation."
      source_data       = var.plugin_archive_base64
      source_media_type = "application/zip"
    }
  ]
  plugins_revision = var.plugin_archive_revision
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `capability_directories` (List of String) Absolute capability directories discovered by the harness.
- `env` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Environment variable values. Write-only; not read back. Change `env_revision` to send an update.
- `env_revision` (Number) Non-secret revision. Increment to send `env` values.
- `files` (Attributes List) Workspace files. Inline `data` is write-only and is sent when `files_revision` changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `files_revision` (Number) Non-secret revision. Increment to upload inline file bytes.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `network` (Attributes) Network policy for hosted environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `packages` (Attributes) Packages to install. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))
- `plugins` (Attributes List) Inline plugin ZIP archives. Archive bytes are write-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))
- `plugins_revision` (Number) Non-secret revision. Increment to upload plugin archives.
- `setup_commands` (Attributes List) Setup commands. Command bodies are write-only; change `setup_commands_revision` to send them again. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setup_commands))
- `setup_commands_revision` (Number) Non-secret revision. Increment to send setup command bodies.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills: inline archives or Skills API references. Archive bytes are write-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `skills_revision` (Number) Non-secret revision. Increment to upload skill archives.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix create timestamp.
- `env_keys` (List of String) Environment variable names returned by the API, if any. Values are never returned.
- `id` (String) Remote template ID.
- `object` (String) Object type.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `path` (String) Destination path under `/workspace`.
- `type` (String) `file_id` or `inline`.

Optional:

- `data` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Base64 inline content. Write-only.
- `file_id` (String) Files API ID when `type` is `file_id`.


<a id="nestedatt--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network`

Optional:

- `access` (String) `enabled`, `disabled`, or `restricted`.
- `allowed_domains` (List of String) Exact host names allowed when access is `restricted`.


<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Optional:

- `npm` (List of String) Global npm packages.
- `python` (List of String) Python packages.
- `system` (List of String) System packages.


<a id="nestedatt--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Required:

- `type` (String) Always `inline` for this release.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Plugin description; must match the manifest.
- `name` (String) Plugin name; must match the manifest.
- `source_data` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Base64 ZIP archive. Write-only.
- `source_media_type` (String) Archive media type. Defaults to `application/zip`.


<a id="nestedatt--setup_commands"></a>
### Nested Schema for `setup_commands`

Optional:

- `command` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Shell command body. Write-only.
- `cwd` (String) Working directory. Observable metadata.


<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Required:

- `type` (String) `inline` or `skill_reference`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Inline description.
- `name` (String) Inline skill or plugin name.
- `skill_id` (String) Existing Skills API object ID.
- `source_data` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Base64 ZIP archive. Write-only.
- `source_media_type` (String) Archive media type. Defaults to `application/zip`.
- `version` (String) Pinned skill version. Omitting it or using `latest` allows future sessions to resolve different content.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openaiagents_environment_template.skills envtpl_abc123
```
